summary: Settings > Labs on the desktop: one row per staged flag (Secret request card, Visual preview, Resume after a usage limit, OpenCode 2, Child chats, Children on other machines, Agent registry search) with a switch, a warning line where the flag carries one, a where and when line and a More disclosure, plus two read-only rows (Run live pages on a phone: set on each phone; Snooze: always on). shared/labs.ts lists the flags once (key labs.<flag>, env var, default, when a change applies, the flag it needs, the capability it advertises) and reads the effective state: env var 1 over the stored labs row over the compiled default, and off while the needed flag is off. Every default stays off. A flag forced by its env var shows Forced on with the switch disabled; Children on other machines is off and disabled while Child chats is off, and its stored row is kept. The switches write the existing settings rows through settings:set; the labs.* rows are now admin-only for writes (ADMIN_ONLY_SETTING_KEYS), so a phone can read them but not switch them. New rows: labs.opencode_v2_acp (read at each OpenCode spawn) and labs.acp_registry_search (read when the Add agent dialog opens). New read channel settings:labs-state answers each flag's forced and on state, never other env. Fix: agent_secret_request_v1 left the fixed BACKEND_CAPABILITIES list and is advertised in ready only while agent_secret_request is on (labsFlagCapabilities, with the two hub capabilities). The shared Switch gets an opaque focus ring with a surface gap and an Off track with a visible line and thumb, and Settings section headings are sentence case without tracking, on every page.

reactNativeIos.reason: The desktop flags are backend settings rows that only the desktop may write; the phone learns the ones it uses from ready capabilities, which it already reads. The phone's own live pages preference stays under Settings > Chat on iOS, so no phone Labs screen is added.

nativeAndroid.reason: Same as iOS: the flags are desktop-written backend rows and the phone reads capabilities. Android keeps its own Settings > Labs with Run live pages.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema change. The labs.* rows are ordinary settings rows; a missing row reads as off, and rows set by hand before keep working.

updateRelease.reason: Ships in the next desktop release with no new flag; every Labs flag keeps its off default.
